# Manager Guide to Leave Approvals

Managers answer leave requests within 3 working days and keep enough of the team available
during peak periods.

## Coverage

No more than 30 percent of a team may be on leave at the same time in December and the
summer months. When requests collide, earlier submitted requests have priority.
